title: Pink Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Countertop Kitchen Paper Towel Valet, Solid Brass, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep paper towels within easy reach while keeping your kitchen countertop clean and uncluttered with a solid brass, freestanding paper towel holder in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to kitchens design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality.

  • Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
  • Clean, modern presence: contemporary, crisp design for today’s kitchens
  • Finish flexibility: available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes
  • Peace of mind: backed by a limited lifetime warranty

Specs

  • Dimensions: 5 in L x 14 in H x 5 in W
  • Material: brass (solid brass construction)
  • Mounting: freestanding
  • Assembly required: no
  • Included: paper towel holder
  • Product weight: 4.8 lb
  • Warranty: limited lifetime
